chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

One who recites the three Surahs of Tawasin (An-Naml, Ash-Shu'ara, and Al-Qasas) on the night of Friday will be among the friends of Allah, in the shelter and protection of Allah, and no hardship will ever befall him in the world. In the Hereafter, he will be given from Paradise until he is pleased, and even beyond his pleasure. Allah will marry him to one hundred Hur al-'Ayn.

key_terms.سُورَةَ الطَّوَاسِينِ: The three Surahs An-Naml, Ash-Shu'ara, and Al-Qasas, collectively referred to as Tawasin

ai.seo_question: What are the rewards for reciting Surah Tawasin on Friday night?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, the 'Tawasin' refers to the three Meccan Surahs—An-Naml, Ash-Shu'ara, and Al-Qasas—whose collective recitation on Friday night is believed to secure divine protection and elevate the believer among Allah's allies, and grant exceptional marital rewards in Paradise. This practice underscores the significance of Friday as a sacred time for spiritual preparation, linking the narrative of the Prophets in these Surahs to the believer's own journey toward divine proximity.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from al-Hussain b. Abi al-’Ala from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

One who recites Surah Tawaseen (Surah Naml, Shuara and Qasas) every Friday eve would be included among the lovers of Allah. He would remain in the protection of Allah. He would never fall prey to helplessness and would get Paradise much more than he desired. The Almighty Allah would marry him to more than one hundred Hoorul Ein.”
